org_code.definition: 2025 NSS reporting-unit identifier; not necessarily one independent legal trust

org_name.definition: Organisation name used in the 2025 source, applied to its reported history

benchmark_group.definition: 2025 reporting benchmark group; historical observations retain this current classification

historically_comparable.definition: Result is provided for this year and organisation is absent from the 2025 no-historical-comparison list; does not establish stable staff membership

complete_five_year_history.definition: All five official burnout scores available and no 2025 no-history flag; intended complete-history cohort indicator

n_eligible.definition: Empty: eligible population is not directly reported in the workbook; not imputed

n_eligible_from_org_rate.definition: Algebraic total n_resp / organisation-specific response_rate; explicitly derived, not directly observed. 2021 rates have limited precision. No national response rate used

n_eff.definition: Empty: individual analysis weights and item-specific missingness by weight group are unavailable

burnout_se.definition: Empty: no aggregate composite standard error supplied

burnout_individual_sd.definition: Empty: individual composite standard deviation unavailable; cannot reconstruct from marginal item percentages without covariance

source_cells.definition: JSON field-to-Excel-cell locator; source_sheet and source SHA retained separately

benchmark_group_vintage.definition: Year whose reporting classification is used: 2025

is_trust.definition: 1 for the five official trust reporting groups; 0 for ICBs, social enterprises, community surgical services

legal_org_code.definition: R1F for the two Isle of Wight sectors, otherwise published org_code; not a comprehensive legal-successor crosswalk

result_available.definition: 1 if a numeric burnout score was published for this unit/year, including current-only units

official_2025_no_history.definition: 1 when code appears in section 8.1 of the 2025 technical guide

comparability_reason.definition: Official 2022–2025 historical-comparability explanation, or missing-history/complete-history status; no outcome-based exclusion

n_eligible_source.definition: Clarifies that direct eligibility counts are absent from this source

n_eligible_derivation.definition: Clarifies derivation and rate-precision limitation for n_eligible_from_org_rate

precision_metadata.definition: Distinguishes nominal counts from unavailable effective sample size and standard errors

release_vintage.definition: Reporting release vintage used for all observations: 2025 survey release, published 2026

weighting.definition: Source weighting for the organisation group; demographic exceptions do not affect retained outcome measures

source_sha256.definition: SHA-256 of the original downloaded workbook
